description: Creates a pending R2F account and emails your human a 6-digit code. Works without a token. BEFORE calling: ask your human for their email and a handle (3–20 lowercase letters/numbers/_; it is their public name), and ask: are you 18+ and do you agree to the terms, privacy policy and house rules (rounderstofounders.com/terms, /privacy, /guidelines)? Only set human_confirmed_18_and_terms true if they said yes. Their real name is optional and stays private unless show_name is true.

newsletter.description: weekly email; default true, ask if unsure
